meta.title: Add kickoff_for_each_parallel method using ThreadPoolExecutor
meta.body_summary: Add a new parallel execution method kickoff_for_each_parallel using ThreadPoolExecutor for running a crew on multiple inputs concurrently, linked to issue #2406.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added parallel execution method; maintainer provided detailed AI-generated review with suggestions; Devin partially addressed feedback but PR auto-closed after 7 days inactivity without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 922 changed lines across 5 files, this is a medium-sized additive feature (most lines in test cassettes). As a performance improvement PR adding parallel execution, it was closed without merge due to inactivity after partial feedback response.

core_change_summary.description: Added kickoff_for_each_parallel method to Crew class using ThreadPoolExecutor to run crew on multiple inputs concurrently. Each input spawns a crew copy via copy.deepcopy, with configurable max_workers. Tests with VCR cassettes verify single/multiple inputs and max_workers behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Cassette YAML files captured HTTP interactions for test isolation; the main implementation is in crew.py (114 lines changed) and test file (211 lines).
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added kickoff_for_each_parallel method and comprehensive test file.
Added VCR test cassettes for deterministic testing.
